Why virtual tours work in Jayanagar

Around the 4th Block shopping complex and the neighbourhood’s busy main roads, Jayanagar customers are loyal but careful. They compare clinics, stores and restaurants closely before they visit — often as a family.

A 360° tour lets them see a clinic’s waiting area, a store’s full range or a restaurant’s seating in advance, which is the same reassurance a personal recommendation gives.

Respecting patients and customers

Healthcare spaces are captured outside consultation hours so no patients appear, and retail stores before opening so displays are shown in full. Sensitive areas are left out unless you want them included.

Frequently asked questions — Jayanagar

Do you shoot 360° virtual tours in Jayanagar?

Yes. Thamco360’s scan crew travels to businesses and properties across Bangalore, including Jayanagar, and deploys within 48 hours of booking. There is no studio to visit — the crew comes to you.

How do you protect patient privacy when shooting a Jayanagar clinic?

Clinic shoots are scheduled outside consultation hours so no patients are captured, screens and records are kept out of frame, and anything sensitive is removed before the tour is published.

Can a retail store in Jayanagar show its full range in a tour?

Yes. Each section of the store is captured, so customers can look around the displays and plan what to see before they visit.

How much does a 360° virtual tour cost in Jayanagar?

Basic Thamco360 packages start from just ₹7,999. The final price depends on the size of the space, the number of scan points and any extras such as a website embed or custom 3D features.
